A `beforeInteractive` script must be in the HTML the server sends, before any Next.js code runs. In the Pages Router, only `pages/_document.js` writes that HTML. In a page or a component, the script isn't part of that HTML and loads later.

Files under an `app/` directory aren't checked. In the App Router, `beforeInteractive` belongs in the root layout.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"@next/next/no-before-interactive-script-outside-document" = "error"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"filename": "pages/index.jsx"} */}
```jsx
import Script from "next/script";

export default function Home() {
  return <Script src="https://example.com/consent.js" strategy="beforeInteractive" />;
}
```

Not reported, in `pages/_document.jsx`:

{/* good {"filename": "pages/_document.jsx"} */}
```jsx
import { Head, Html, Main, NextScript } from "next/document";
import Script from "next/script";

export default function Document() {
  return (
    <Html>
      <Head />
      <body>
        <Main />
        <NextScript />
        <Script src="https://example.com/consent.js" strategy="beforeInteractive" />
      </body>
    </Html>
  );
}
```

Not reported, in `app/layout.jsx`:

{/* good {"filename": "app/layout.jsx"} */}
```jsx
import Script from "next/script";

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        {children}
        <Script src="https://example.com/consent.js" strategy="beforeInteractive" />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```
